_key.description: Genomic element key and phenotype ontology term joined by an underscore.

z_score.title: Z-Score
z_score.description: Average phenotype z-score across guides targeting the genomic element

p_value.title: P-Value
p_value.description: P-value for the element's association with the screened phenotype.

neg_log10_pvalue.title: Negative Log10 P-Value
neg_log10_pvalue.description: Negative log 10 p-value of the measurement or prediction

significant.title: Significant?
significant.description: Boolean indicator of the significance of the element's effect on the phenotype.
significant.threshold: The adapter preserves mig_significant for migration screens or growth_significant for proliferation screens. The source defines the significance and guide-hit criteria; their numerical cutoffs are not documented in the adapter. Neither p_value nor z_score is thresholded again, and nonsignificant rows are retained.

num_guides.title: Number of Guides
num_guides.description: Number of guides targeting the pertubed element in the screen.

num_guides_hit.title: Number of Hit Guides
num_guides_hit.description: Number of guides classified as hits by the source.
num_guides_hit.threshold: Source-defined guide-hit criteria; numerical cutoffs are not documented in the adapter. These counts/fractions are not used to recalculate significant.

num_guides_nonhit.title: Number of Non-Hit Guides
num_guides_nonhit.description: Number of guides classified as non-hits by the source.
num_guides_nonhit.threshold: Source-defined guide-hit criteria; numerical cutoffs are not documented in the adapter. These counts/fractions are not used to recalculate significant.

fraction_guides_hit.title: Fraction of Hit Guides
fraction_guides_hit.description: Fraction of guides classified as hits by the source.
fraction_guides_hit.threshold: Source-defined guide-hit criteria; numerical cutoffs are not documented in the adapter. These counts/fractions are not used to recalculate significant.
